detail.longDescription: New blog post: I have seen a lot of testing code that used some mocking library to mock way too many dependencies in unit tests. The thinking seems to go like this: A unit test is supposed to test a single class only, so anything that this class depends on must not influence the test, so let's mock everything that is passed into the class by our dependency injection framework. This is a bad idea. In this post, I share my heuristics on when to mock and when not to. https:// sebastian-hans.de/blog/to-mock -or-not-to-mock/ # softwareEngineering # softwareDevelopment # programming # testing
